Design direction

We wanted Schultz’ Studios to feel different from a typical portfolio or studio website. Instead of going for a very neutral or corporate look, we built the concept around space, exploration and the idea of moving towards the future.

Why Schultz’?

The name Schultz comes from Schultz’ Gate, the first street we lived on when we moved to Norway.

Moving to another country was a big step for us, and that street became a symbol of that new beginning.

Naming the studio after that street felt natural. Now, it also represents another step forward: creating a space where we can build, experiment and grow together.
